title: 协议、阈值与测试指标
配对区间与失败场景
cells:
model=fit()
parts=[model['rows'],records(),records('test')]
ids=[{r['id'] for r in rows} for rows in parts]
groups=[{r['group'] for r in rows} for rows in parts]
assert all(not (ids[i]&ids[j]) and not (groups[i]&groups[j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(i))
assert max(r['time'] for r in parts[0])<min(r['time'] for r in parts[1])
assert max(r['time'] for r in parts[1])<min(r['time'] for r in parts[2])
positive=[dict(id='edge',group='edge',time=0,x=0.0,y=1)]
negative=[dict(id='edge',group='edge',time=0,x=0.0,y=0)]
print(json.dumps({'splitSizes':[len(p) for p in parts],'groups':[len(g) for g in groups],'quantileRanks':[math.ceil(p*4**4) for p in [0.025,0.975]],'positiveOnly':metrics(positive,model,None),'negativeOnly':metrics(negative,model,None)},ensure_ascii=False))
